subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should the answer-candidate Activity surface land as a narrow rebased slice, or should it be folded into the broader native Codex progress UX tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The patch is useful and proven, but current main has changed the UI architecture and the broader issue is explicitly product/privacy-sensitive; automation cannot choose the permanent Control UI surface for maintainers.

options.title: Ask for a focused rebase
options.body: Have the contributor adapt the same answer-candidate lifecycle to current ui/src/pages/activity and ui/src/pages/chat paths, preserving preamble/tool handling and re-running the focused UI/Codex proof.

options.title: Fold into broader Codex progress work
options.body: Keep this PR open only as reference material and implement answer candidates together with the broader safe Codex progress surface from the canonical issue.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers decide Activity should not show final-answer candidate lifecycle separately from final reply delivery.

recommendation.title: Ask for a focused rebase
recommendation.body: Have the contributor adapt the same answer-candidate lifecycle to current ui/src/pages/activity and ui/src/pages/chat paths, preserving preamble/tool handling and re-running the focused UI/Codex proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the earlier broader native Codex Activity/progress PR and the original Activity surface this PR extends.
